title: Library Interlibrary Loan Inquiry
audioPrompt: Excuse me, I need a sociology monograph for my research paper that isn't on our open shelves. Is there any way to request it from another campus library?
options: The sociology department faculty offices are located on the third floor of Hall Hall.
Yes, you can submit an interlibrary loan request through your library portal, and it usually arrives in three business days.
You will need to re-enroll in the introductory sociology survey course next semester.
Books on the reserve shelf can only be checked out for two hours at a time.
why: The student asked how to request a book from another campus library; confirming that an interlibrary loan request can be placed online is the direct and natural response.

All students must purchase a laboratory coat and safety goggles before Monday's experiment.

why: The professor explains why the prerequisite cannot be waived due to the mathematical requirements of the course.
